case_title: CHRISTINE LENA REED VS. ROBERT BRAY

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-12-2019 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF REED, CHRISTINE LENA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BRAY, ROBERT $400.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $400.00, DEFENDANT TENDERLOIN HOUSING CLINIC SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF CHRISTINE LENA REED. BASED ON THE EVIDENCE SUBMITTED COURT FINDS TENDERLOIN HOUSING CLINIC IS THE DEFENDANT NOT THEIR EMPLOYEE ROBERT BRAY. COURT FINDS PLAINTIFF LEFT PROPERTY IN COMMON AREA BUT THAT DEFENDANT'S ACTIONS IN DISCARDING PROPERTY WITHOUT FURTHER CHECKING ON SOURCE OF PROPERTY ACTED NEGLIGENTLY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-02-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,000.00 FILED BY REED, CHRISTINE LENA AS TO DEFENDANT BRAY, ROBERT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-12-2019 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF REED, CHRISTINE LENA ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-12-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-12-2019 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF CHRISTINE LENA REED IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ROBERT BRAY IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE WAS FILED. PLAINTIFF HAD PROOF FILLED OUT BUT IT WAS NOT FILED. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE ISSUES. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
